features.title: Headless engine core
features.description: packages/cad/src/cad.ts: mm units and expression parsing, Pt maths, line/polyline/circle/arc/spline/text/dimension/hatch/point/leader/insert/section entities, layers, blocks, command + invertible patch undo, drawing and edit commands, picking, snapping.
acceptance: every mutation goes through a Command whose patch is exactly invertible
undo/redo restores entity and layer state byte for byte
a zero-length line is refused without touching the document or history
locked and frozen layers are invisible to picking and selection
all coordinates in the document are millimetres

features.title: Constraint solver and driving dimensions
features.description: projectScene/writeBack/solveDocument/solveAnchor with a damped Newton least-squares solver, constraint catalogue, pinVars, parameter expressions, SOLVE_RESIDUAL_LIMIT, and failure reporting instead of NaN.
acceptance: a driving dimension moves free geometry to the parameter value
an unsatisfiable system reports constraints do not fit and never writes NaN
a system with no free variables reports failure instead of silently succeeding
a constraint naming deleted geometry is reported, not thrown
constraintFromPairs rejects the wrong number of variables
solver reads live state while Newton is probing, not a stale snapshot

features.title: Coverage backed by the suite and smoke
features.description: packages/cad/test/cad.test.ts covers units, geometry, undo, selection, layers, dimensions, expressions, solver, offset, fillet, join, DXF round-trip, project IO, fit, plot and contract; scripts/smoke.mjs drives the same paths headless.
acceptance: vitest reports every test passing
typecheck reports no errors under strict + noUncheckedIndexedAccess + exactOptionalPropertyTypes
smoke covers draw, solve, refused dimension, DXF round-trip, project save/load and a 1:10 plot

features.title: DXF and project IO
features.description: writeDxf/readDxf (layers, header vars, units) and the .dwgcad JSON project format with SCHEMA_VERSION and forward-only migrations.
acceptance: a drawing round-trips through DXF with entities and layers intact
a hand-written R12 file is read and what is skipped is reported

features.title: App shell
features.description: apps/app: Vite + canvas drafting viewport with pan/zoom, layer panel, command line, snapping toggles, selection set, undo/redo, open/save DXF and project.

features.title: Dimension editing in the UI
features.description: Click a driving dimension, type a new value, and the drawing solves live; unsatisfiable edits show the failure and keep the old geometry.

constraint glyphs are drawn next to the geometry they hold
